decisions.reason: Adding the Sensor board to the combined order after missing parts are resolved does not change the required production-file package.
The ordering sequence does not change any Sensor-board BOM content or assembly-readiness requirement.
Waiting for the manufacturer to identify missing parts affects order timing, not the current component-sourceability policy or selections.
The combined-order sequence has no effect on KiCad project portability or library resolution.
Adding the Sensor board to a later manufacturing order does not alter rail-monitoring behavior or coverage.
The source changes when the Sensor board will be ordered, not its sensor-module connectors or interface definitions.
The ordering decision leaves the interboard topology, connector types, and pinouts unchanged.
The Sensor-board order sequence does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or required I2C mode.
The manufacturing-order timing does not alter the Sensor board's logic-level or level-shifter requirements.
Ordering all boards together does not change the Main board's dimensions, orientation, or connector placement.
The source affects when the Sensor board enters the order, not its mechanical layout or connector positioning.
The combined manufacturing-order sequence does not alter DCDC1 voltage configuration or regulation behavior.
